area: southbound Highway 204 at the connector onto Highway 99
disposition: four patients tagged green; a second ambulance was started
summary: A vehicle rollover on the southbound Highway 204 connector onto Highway 99 brought a full fire assignment. Crews reported four patients, all tagged green, and a second ambulance was started to the scene while one engine was canceled.

area: the 5500 block of Valpredo Avenue, at a cold storage building
disposition: no visible fire; crews got inside the room
summary: Firefighters were sent to a structure fire response at a cold storage building on Valpredo Avenue. Truck 54 reported water flowing from one room and nothing from another, and crews laddered the building looking for a heat source. They got into the room and found nothing visible.

area: northbound Highway 155 north of Boulder Gulch, in the Kern River canyon
disposition: patient condition unknown; cell contact poor
summary: A vehicle hit the front of the mountain and rolled over on northbound Highway 155 about a mile south of Hungry Gulch. Radio traffic described poor cell phone reception with the patient, and the wrecked vehicle was reported blocking the roadway.

Officers were sent to Beardsley Avenue for a disturbance involving a man on a motorized bike who was reported to be carrying a machete. He was last seen fleeing eastbound on the bike with a checkered backpack.

area: eastbound Highway 58 near South Union Avenue
summary: Multiple callers reported brush burning along eastbound Highway 58 near South Union Avenue. County engines were joined by city equipment sent to the grass fire.

disposition: one additional engine requested; power lines in the area
summary: Firefighters in Wasco found a large debris pile burning. Crews expected to knock most of the heat down themselves but called for one additional engine, and reported power lines in the area that did not appear to be affected.

area: the 5300 block of Cherry Creek Lane
disposition: man with a knife; mental health call
summary: Officers were sent to Cherry Creek Lane for a disturbance involving a man who had been drinking, was bleeding after punching a wall, and was reported to be in possession of a knife. A possible mental health episode was noted, and he was advised to disarm himself when units returned.
A caller reported that a man battered a woman and took a juvenile into a vehicle, then fled in a white pickup.
Units were told to broadcast for officer safety after one caller reported hearing a single shot in the area of California Avenue.
A missing-person report went out for an adult described as gravely disabled and last seen on foot around 7 p.m.

disposition: deputies sent for a welfare check
summary: Deputies were sent to Tungsten Street for a welfare check on a juvenile who was reported to be texting family members with threats toward them.

area: the 4300 block of Long Canyon Road
summary: Deputies were sent to Long Canyon Road to check on a juvenile reported to be having thoughts of harming themselves.

area: the 5000 block of East Commerce Way
summary: Officers checked a door found unsecured at a business on East Commerce Way. There was no forced entry, and patrol units were still en route to secure the building.
A caller reported a garage door standing wide open at a home on Glenmont Drive with no vehicles outside, saying the house was occupied. Nobody answered the doorbell or a knock at the door.
Officers were sent to the 6300 block of White Lane for a vandalism call with spray paint reported.

area: South Martin Luther King Jr Boulevard
disposition: emergency traffic; stolen out of Los Angeles
summary: Officers moved to emergency traffic on a green 1997 Toyota pickup that a Los Angeles agency reported stolen, with a driver and a passenger reported inside.
Firefighters were sent to a report of a building on fire on 34th Street. Nothing hazardous was showing from the outside, the building was locked down, and the alarm company was contacted.

Officers looked for a newer dark gray sedan with silver rims that left the area after a caller reported impact sounds at a building on Westwind Drive. The vehicle was reported fleeing toward 21st Street and Oak Street.

area: a community park on Buckingham Way
summary: Officers were sent to a community park on Buckingham Way for a report of someone living under the pavilion.

disposition: caller heard a loud noise; officers sent
summary: A caller on Wilson Road reported a loud noise coming from a detached garage, and officers were sent to check the property.

area: East Brundage Lane and Oswell Street
summary: Firefighters were sent to East Brundage Lane and Oswell Street for a small grass fire burning near an auto parts store.

area: Highway 14 north of Joplin Canyon Road
summary: Deputies were sent to a trespass call on Highway 14 north of Joplin Canyon Road and checked for a white Toyota pickup.
Medics were sent to Williams Court for a traumatic injury.
Fire crews were sent to an outside fire burning on the curb at Roberts Lane and Airport Drive.

area: eastbound Highway 166 east of Elkhorn Grade
summary: A driver on eastbound Highway 166 east of Elkhorn Grade reported that a semi driver threw an object at her vehicle after passing, damaging her windshield. A broadcast went out for the semi with a red or maroon cab pulling a white trailer.
Unstable van and trailer reported on I-5.
Man found unconscious at panda express in bakersfield.
Light smoke from house fire on North Kern Street.
